source_quotes: if a string has more than 2 consecutive spaces,
then replace all consecutive spaces with -
reason: The first replacement maps a maximal space run to an underscore run of equal length. The selected literal replacement then consumes non-overlapping groups of three underscores, rather than the entire maximal run. A four-space run leaves one underscore after the marker, and a six-space run produces two markers, although the public contract requires one marker for each complete run longer than two spaces.
distinguishing_input_class: Strings containing a maximal run of four or six spaces, bounded by nonspace characters: 'a    b' must become 'a-b', while the source produces 'a-_b'; six spaces must likewise produce one hyphen rather than two.
